description: This file defines the 'LogNode' interface used for a logging system within the Android project. It specifies a contract for classes that output log data, with a method to print log entries with associated metadata.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging node that can output log data to a target, supporting chaining of multiple nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable for exceptions.

calls: println(int priority, String tag, String msg, Throwable tr)
